verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents versioning, review, or rollback of workflow or agent definitions. Time travel (mastra-docs-41) and snapshots (mastra-docs-39) operate on individual run state: they replay or resume execution, which is a different capability from versioning or rolling back the automation itself. Keeping code-defined workflows in git would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
